product_overview: Proton Enterprise is a lightweight, role-based web frontend for managing and browsing an electrical-goods inventory. Admins get full CRUD product management while Viewers have a read-only dashboard for searching and referencing current inventory.
core_goals: Allow store managers (Admins) to create, view, update, and delete electrical product listings.
Allow floor staff and contractors (Viewers) to browse and search the current inventory in a read-only mode.
Provide a simple, role-driven authentication flow that redirects users to the appropriate dashboard.
Surface product counts, search results, and pagination so users can quickly find and reference items.

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate an existing user with username and password, store JWT and role locally, and redirect the user to the correct dashboard based on role.
user_flows: Navigate to /index.html -> Fill username input field -> Fill password input field -> Submit login form -> See success banner and auto-redirect to /admin.html (admin role)
Navigate to /index.html -> Fill username input field -> Fill password input field -> Submit login form -> See success banner and auto-redirect to /viewer.html (viewer role)
Navigate to /index.html -> Submit login form with empty required fields -> See inline error messages for required fields
Navigate to /index.html -> Fill username and password with incorrect credentials -> Submit login form -> See global error banner indicating invalid credentials

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Create a new account by providing full name, username, password and selecting a role; on success the user is returned to the login page.
user_flows: Navigate to /register.html -> Fill full name -> Fill username -> Select role (Admin or Viewer) -> Fill password -> Submit registration form -> See success alert and auto-redirect to /index.html
Navigate to /register.html -> Fill username shorter than required -> Submit registration form -> See inline validation error for username min length
Navigate to /register.html -> Fill form without selecting a role -> Submit registration form -> See inline validation error requiring a role selection

features.name: Auth Guard / Role-Based Redirect
features.description: Prevent unauthenticated or incorrectly privileged users from accessing dashboards and auto-redirect already-authenticated users away from auth pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin.html without an auth token -> Be redirected to /index.html
Navigate to /viewer.html without an auth token -> Be redirected to /index.html
Navigate to /viewer.html with a logged-in role that is not viewer -> Be redirected to /index.html
Navigate to /index.html while already logged in as admin -> Be redirected to /admin.html
Navigate to /index.html while already logged in as viewer -> Be redirected to /viewer.html

features.name: Admin Product Management
features.description: Admins can view the product catalogue, search and paginate results, and perform create, update, and delete operations on products; the UI reflects product counts and updates after changes.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin.html (authenticated as admin) -> See product list rendered in a data table -> See total product count in stats card
Navigate to /admin.html -> Open Add Product modal -> Fill product form (name, brand, specification, price, unit, category) -> Save product -> See new product appear in the list and total count update
Navigate to /admin.html -> Open Edit Product modal for an existing product (pre-filled) -> Update product details -> Save changes -> See product row update with new details
Navigate to /admin.html -> Initiate delete for a product -> Confirm deletion -> See product removed from the list and total count update
Navigate to /admin.html -> Enter a search query in the topbar -> See product list filtered to matching items and the stats card update
Navigate to /admin.html -> Use pagination controls to change page -> See table update to show the corresponding page slice

features.name: Viewer Product Dashboard
features.description: Read-only dashboard for viewers to browse, search and paginate the product catalogue and view informational cards relevant to shop-floor activities.
user_flows: Navigate to /viewer.html (authenticated as viewer) -> See product list rendered in a read-only data table -> See total product count in stats card
Navigate to /viewer.html -> Enter a search query in the topbar -> See filtered product list and updated total count
Navigate to /viewer.html -> Use pagination controls to change page -> See table update to show the corresponding page slice
Navigate to /viewer.html -> Scroll to info cards -> Read informational cards about inventory policy, market trends, and sync status

features.name: Logout
features.description: Clear stored authentication and role information and return the user to the login page.
user_flows: While on /admin.html -> Trigger logout -> Be redirected to /index.html
While on /viewer.html -> Trigger logout -> Be redirected to /index.html

routes.description: Login page for Proton Enterprise - accepts username and password credentials
User registration page - create account with role selection (Admin/Viewer)
Admin Products Portal - full CRUD management of electrical inventory products
Read-only Viewer Dashboard - displays electrical inventory products with search

features.name: User Login
features.description: Login with username and password credentials; JWT token and role stored in localStorage; redirects to admin or viewer dashboard based on role
user_interactions: Fill username input field
Fill password input field
Toggle password visibility via eye button
Click "Login to Terminal" button to submit
See inline error messages on empty fields
See global error banner on invalid credentials
See success banner and auto-redirect on successful login

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Create a new account with full name, username, password and role (admin or viewer); redirects to login on success
user_interactions: Fill full name input
Fill username input
Select role (Admin or Viewer) via radio buttons
Fill password input
Toggle password visibility
Click "Register" button to submit
See inline validation errors
See success or error alert banner

features.name: Auth Guard / Role-Based Redirect
features.description: Protects admin.html and viewer.html from unauthenticated access; redirects based on stored role; already-logged-in users skip auth pages
user_interactions: Navigate to admin.html without token - redirected to index.html
Navigate to viewer.html without token - redirected to index.html
Navigate to index.html already logged in - auto-redirected to role dashboard

features.name: Admin Product Management
features.description: Full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) for electrical inventory products with search, pagination, and stats card
user_interactions: View product list in a data table with columns Name, Brand, Category, Unit, Price, Actions
See total product count in stats card
Search products using the search input in topbar
Click "Add Product" or "+ Add New Item" button to open Add Product modal
Fill product form (name, brand, specification, price, unit, category) and click Save Product
Click Edit button on a product row to open Edit Product modal with pre-filled data
Update product details and save
Click Delete button on a product row to open Delete Confirmation modal
Confirm deletion by clicking "Delete Item"
Cancel deletion by clicking "Cancel"
Click Logout button in sidebar or topbar to log out and return to login page

features.name: Viewer Product Dashboard
features.description: Read-only view of the electrical inventory product list with search, pagination, and informational cards
user_interactions: View product list in a data table with columns Name, Brand, Category, Unit, Price (no Actions column)
See total product count in stats card
Search products using the search input in topbar
Click Logout button in sidebar or topbar to log out and return to login page

features.name: Logout
features.description: Clears auth_token and auth_role from localStorage and redirects to index.html login page
user_interactions: Click Logout button in sidebar
Click Logout icon button in topbar

known_limitations.issue: Pagination controls in admin.html and viewer.html are static HTML placeholders; no JS wires up dynamic page navigation
known_limitations.impact: Clicking pagination buttons may not navigate between pages if backend returns full list

known_limitations.issue: Export List and Export CSV buttons have no implementation
The authGuard role check for viewer page redirects any non-viewer role back to login instead of admin page; admins cannot visit viewer.html
known_limitations.impact: Admins are locked out of viewer dashboard

known_limitations.issue: password toggle button in login/register may not update icon state visually
